test_title: PYST 7 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: How is graphic design utilized in our everyday lives?

options.text: To entertain audiences and promote entertainment services
To create visual appeal without any specific function
To influence understanding, marketing, and branding
To only improve the aesthetic quality of spaces and products

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3: ****To influence understanding, marketing, and branding**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• Graphic design is a powerful tool used to influence understanding, marketing, and branding in everyday life. 
 
• It helps in creating visually compelling messages that convey ideas and information effectively. 
 
• Through logos, advertisements, product packaging, and digital content, graphic design plays a vital role in shaping consumer perceptions and behaviors. 
 
• It connects businesses with their audiences by building a strong and recognizable brand identity. 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Explanation:** * Graphic design is not just about aesthetics; it involves strategic visual communication to achieve specific goals such as marketing, branding, and influencing understanding. * 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• **Option 1:** While graphic design is used to entertain audiences and promote entertainment services, this is only one of its many applications. 
 
• **Option 2:** Creating visual appeal without any specific function is not the primary purpose of graphic design. It is inherently functional and goal-oriented. 
 
• **Option 4:** Improving aesthetic quality is a part of graphic design, but its scope extends far beyond just aesthetics.
